name: git2txt
postCreateCommand: npm install -g git2txt && git2txt username/repository && git2txt git@github.com:username/repository && git2txt https://github.com/username/repository && git2txt username/repository && git2txt git@github.com:username/repository && git2txt username/repository --output=output.txt && git2txt username/repository --threshold=2 && git2txt username/repository --include-all && git2txt username/repository --debug
